Ref:   Intimation regarding rescheduling of Earnings Conference Call for the second quarter

Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Further to our disclosure dated October 22, 2026, regarding the schedule of the Earnings Call, we 
wish to inform that the timing of the Earnings Conference Call for the second quarter and half year 
ended September 30, 2026, to be held on Thursday, November 5, 2026, has been revised from 
1700 Hours (IST) to 1730 Hours (IST). The details for registration and for joining the call are 
enclosed. 
 
The above is for your kind information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly,
